title: How to scale content output without scaling headcount
topic: Using AI-assisted pipelines so a small team can publish more, higher-quality content
angle: The leverage comes from a repeatable brief-to-draft pipeline plus a human review gate, not from replacing editors
audience: Founders and content leads at small, fast-moving teams
keyPoints: Why throughput, not headcount, is the real constraint on content output
The brief -> draft -> review loop and why the human gate stays
What to automate (drafting, enrichment, SEO metadata) vs. what to keep human (judgment, voice, fact-checking)
How to measure unit economics: cost and time per published piece
notes: End with a concrete next step the reader can take this week.
